responsibility: Serves as the central traits module entry point, wiring together submodules, re-exporting the main trait-selection APIs and data types, defining shared fulfillment error structures and utility checks, and registering trait-related query providers for the crate.
same_name_distinction: This is the root `traits` module. Unlike the other `traits/*/mod.rs` files, which each head a specific subsystem, it is the crate-wide assembly layer that wires trait machinery together, re-exports the main APIs and shared types, and installs trait-related query providers.
